text: The General's Shield is a leveled shield with a Reflect Damage enchantment. It can be found as random loot.
The Gauldur Blackbow is a leveled unique Ancient Nord bow found in .
The Gauldur Blackblade is a leveled unique Ancient Nord Sword in .
General Tullius' Armor is a unique piece of Heavy Armor worn by General Tullius. It consists of only one part—the cuirass. It shares its base armor rating with the steel armor cuirass.
Gharol's Message is a quest available in initiated by Gharol the blacksmith in Dushnikh Yal. The Dragonborn is asked to deliver a sword to Gharol's daughter, Lash in Karthwasten.

General Goods Merchants can be found in almost every city in Skyrim. These merchants buy and sell most items. This includes: *Weapons and armor. *Clothing and jewelry *Food and ingredients *Housebuilding Items *Potions *Scrolls and books *Miscellaneous items
The Gauntlets of the Old Gods are a unique piece of light armor and part of the Armor of the Old Gods set found in .

General Carius Armor is a piece of Heavy Armor worn by General Falx Carius. It cannot be obtained without the use of console commands, or a glitch involving the spiders the Dragonborn can create on Solstheim. It has the same appearance as General Tullius' Armor, but is darker in color and includes a Heart Stone.
Ghani at-Halma is a Redguard clothier residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. He has a stall where he sells his wares in the indoor market Aldcroft Anvil & Armor, opposite the Dockside Green market.
Gauntlets are an armor type in . They protect hands and wrists. Gauntlets are different from bracers, which only cover the wrist.
Gharakul is an Orsimer armorer residing in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane. She can be found at her store, Gharakul's Pinch-Free Armor, selling her wares.
General Vette's Greatsword is an item found in . It is a quest reward for completing "Breaking the Tide." It is part of the Armor of the Trainee set.
Gateslayer Axe may refer to: *Gateslayer Axe (Creature) *Gateslayer Axe (Item)

The Gauntlets of the Lunar Bastion are a heavy armor chest piece in obtained from the Maw of Lorkhaj trial. The Gauntlets may be dropped by bosses or obtained from the Dro-m'Athra's Burnished Coffer or Dro-m'Athra's Shining Coffer during the course of the quest "Into the Maw." The Gauntlets are a part of the Lunar Bastion item set.

Gharen was a famous Dwemer blacksmith who created the eponymous Hammer of Gharen. It is said that the hammer, together with the Anvil of Mithas, could produce the finest armor and weapons and that only the hammer was strong enough not to shatter upon the mighty enchanted anvil. When used together, they would also reveal the entrance to the dwarven mines beneath Dagoth-Ur. The Eternal Champion retrieved the hammer and brought it to King Casik of Ebontheart in exchange for the mountains location, which housed the eighth and final piece of the Staff of Chaos.
Gilyan Sedas is Dunmer Assassin found in the Balmora Morag Tong Guild. He offers training in Short Blade, Light Armor and Marksman.
Glacial Wall is an expert-level Alteration spell in . Upon cast, it increases the caster's frost resistance and armor rating by 30% for 30 seconds.

Ghosts are undead spirits that cannot be harmed by ordinary physical attacks but can be damaged by magic, silver, daedric, enchanted weapons (the weapon does not need to have a charge to be effective), or hand-to-hand (Journeyman) combat. Though ghosts are usually enemies, not all are hostile, some may even send the Hero on quests.

Gjukar's Monument is a landmark found in . It is southeast of Rorikstead, near Broken Fang Cave. A low-leveled sword and a leveled shield lie at the base of the monument. This monument was constructed to mark the site of a battle that took place in ancient times. Gjukar was the commander of a platoon that had set up camp nearby. He was killed here along with the rest of his men.
Ghostblade is a unique ancient Nord sword, and one of the four unique ghost weapons available to the Dragonborn in .
Girduin was a Bosmer sorcerer who was part of an expedition to Labyrinthian, and can be seen during the quest "The Staff of Magnus."
The Gilded Wristguards are a pair of unique light armor gauntlets in .
Casnar is the Ghost of a Redguard Blade who can be found inside Sancre Tor. He, along with Alain, Valdemar, and Rielus, are trapped inside the prison section. His skeleton wields Mishaxhi's Cleaver.
Rielus is an Imperial Blade who has been trapped as an undead creature imprisoned in the ruined fort of Sancre Tor. His skeleton holds the Amulet of the Ansei.

Gils Oril is a Dunmer Battlmage residing in the Daedric Shrine of Tusenend in the Molag Amur region. He has no unique dialogue and wears Steel Armor. As he and the other occupants of the shrine are Daedra worshippers, he will attack the Nerevarine on sight. He is accompanied by three other worshippers in the Shrine: the Nords Barirrid and Val and the Orsimer Nargol gra-Uftharz, all of whom are Barbarians except for Oril himself, who is a Battlemage.

Ghorbash's Ancestral Axe is a one-handed axe in . It was supposed to be obtainable during a radiant quest given by potential follower/marriage prospect Ghorbash the Iron Hand in Dushnikh Yal, but was cut from the game. It cannot be obtained without the use of console commands.
Gjalund Salt-Sage is the captain of the Northern Maiden and can be found in Windhelm Docks aboard his ship.
Ghostgate Shrine Blessing is a spell available in that increases the subject's magicka and armor rating.
Gilzir is a Redguard found in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He is the boatswain on the ship in the harbor. He can arrange passage for Stros M'Kai.
Giant Camp is a world boss location in the Alik'r Desert. It is found north of Leki's Blade.
Gjarmi is a Nord found aboard The Blasted Breton, a retired ship in Alten Corimont.
The Ghost Vipers are a faction that appears in . They are Ghosts that accompany Captain Blanchete at his Wrecked Ship.
Ghost Fanatic Archers are hostile Nords that appear during the "Ghosts of Vitharn" quest in . They are clad in a full suit of Madness Armor and carry a Madness Bow.
Gladius is a Short Blade found in that has a weapon rating of 35.
Ghost Sighting is a book in that is a part of the Spell Knight Armor Creation Club content.
Ghost Knight is a character in that is a part of the Spell Knight Armor Creation Club content.
Giant Bull Netch is a creature in that is a part of the Netch Leather Armor Creation Club content.
Giant Betty Netch Leather is a miscellaneous item in that is a part of the Netch Leather Armor Creation Club content.
Giant Bull Netch Leather is a miscellaneous item in that is a part of the Netch Leather Armor Creation Club content.

Glass armor is the strongest form of light armor in , being principally made from Malachite. The Dunmer are the masters of light armor design, and glass armor is the pinnacle of that design. Inspired by traditional High Elven ornate armors, this very expensive armor utilizes malachite studded into different parts of the armor in order to absorb and distribute shocks in a manner much more efficient than steel. It is also valued for being light and flexible, granting the wearer a superior range of movement than similar strength armors.

Goblin Warlord is a very large, strong, armored goblin. It wields a variety of weapons and a shield. Like the shaman, it will level alongside the Hero, so it will always prove to be a challenge even at higher levels. They will usually attack the Hero with poisoned weapons or arrows, or even charge straight in with their fists. They can also have master-level combat skills, possessing the ability to knock down or paralyze. Using an enchanted weapon during combat is recommended at higher levels.
The Goblin Totem Staff is a staff often wielded by goblin shamans. There are actually several different Goblin Totem Staves, with each goblin tribe possessing one.
The Glass Dagger is a one-handed weapon that can be found throughout Skyrim.
A Glass Helmet is a piece of light armor and part of the Glass Armor set found in .
Glass Boots are a piece of light armor and part of the Glass Armor set found in .
Glass Gauntlets are a piece of light armor and part of the glass armor set found in .
The Glass Shield is a piece of light armor and part of the Glass Armor set found in .
The Goblin Shaman Staff is a unique staff constructed from the severed head of a Goblin, and it is the first staff that can be acquired in the game. __NOTOC__

Glass Left Pauldron is a type of Glass Armor found in . Its effectiveness is determined by the wearer's skill level in Light Armor. At higher levels, bandits and other humanoid enemies will wear this armor.
Glass Right Pauldron is a type of Light Armor and part of the Glass Armor set. At higher levels, bandits and other humanoid enemies will wear this armor.

The Glass Cuirass is a piece of the glass armor set. Its effectiveness is determined by the Nerevarine's skill level in Light Armor. At higher levels, bandits and other humanoid enemies will wear this armor.
The Glass Greaves are a piece of light armor and part of the glass armor set. At higher levels, bandits and other humanoid enemies will wear this armor.
Glass Tower Shield is a piece of light armor and part of the Glass Armor set in .
Glass Jinkblade is a one-handed glass weapon. This enchanted short blade inflicts paralysis, rendering an adversary unable to move or perform most actions for ten seconds.
Glass Netch Dagger is a glass short blade that is enchanted with Destruction magic. This generic dagger can be found at a variety of locations throughout Morrowind.
Gloves can be worn on the hands, but cannot be worn along with gauntlets or bracers and provide no armor. However, they can be Enchanted to provide benefits such as Fortify Pickpocket, etc.

Glenroy's Akaviri Katana is a unique weapon wielded by Glenroy, a member of the Blades present during the tutorial of . It is the second unique weapon obtainable by the Hero without the use of console commands.
Glass Bow of the Stag Prince is a unique glass bow found in .
Goblinslayer Chausses is a pair of heavy armor leggings the Vestige receive after completing the quest "Tarnish the Crown."
Gnats Storm-Hammer is a Nord residing at the Tedas House in the town of Narsis, Deshaan.
Glass Hand Axes are weapons found in . They can be gathered as loot, or crafted at the blacksmith. It is a light, cleaving weapon.
Glass Light Hammers are weapons found in . They can be gathered as loot, or crafted at the blacksmith. It is a light, bashing weapon.

Golden Saint Armor is a set of heavy armor obtained from Staada after The Helpless Army quest in . There is no other way to obtain it without the use of console commands. The armor uses the boots, greaves, gauntlets and cuirass slots. The Hero also receives the Golden Saint Helmet with the suit. The Golden Saint Shield must be obtained separately from a fallen Golden Saint.

The Golden Mace is a Blunt weapon which can be taken from Golden Saints. There are two types of the mace, regular and worn. They are rarely used in combat and can be looted from the corpse of a Golden Saint Guard.
The Golden Ship Model is one of several possible target items for Vex's Thieves Guild quests "The Burglary Job" and "The Sweep Job," and serves as one of the Thieves Guild Trophies.

Goras Andrelo is a Dunmer scout. He is a member of House Redoran and is a minor skill trainer in Athletics, Long Blade, and Block. He can be found residing in his house, within the Redoran Council Hall in the city of Ald'ruhn.
Goldbrand is a unique weapon in . It is one of the artifacts of the Daedric Prince Boethiah.
The Golden War Axe is a Blunt weapon carried by the Golden Saints in .
The Golden Shortsword is a weapon carried by Golden Saints in .
The Golden Bow is a bow carried by Golden Saint archers in the . There are two types of the Golden Bow; regular and worn. They can be looted from the corpse of a Golden Saint Guard.

Golden Saint Shield is a heavy shield carried by Golden Saints in . The Golden Saint Shield is part of the Golden Saint Armor set. Most Golden Saints wear a leveled version of the shield. The Shield features flame markings on it, a possible reference to the Cold Flame of Agnon which represents Sheogorath's power.
Golden Saint Weapons is a weapon set in . They are wielded by Golden Saints in the Shivering Isles.
Grace, formerly Recovery, is a passive skill in the Light Armor skill line in .
Gogrikh is an Orsimer merchant residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh. He is a clothier selling light armor at Stonetooth Smithy.
Gold Armor is a type of Medium Armor in . It was added as part of the LeFemm Armor plug-in.
Gold Cuirass is a piece of the Gold Armor set in . It was added as part of the LeFemm Armor plug-in.
Gold Helmet is a piece of the Gold Armor set in . It was added as part of the LeFemm Armor plug-in.
Gold Left Pauldron is a piece of the Gold Armor set in . It was added as part of the LeFemm Armor plug-in.
Gold Right Pauldron is a piece of the Gold Armor set in . It was added as part of the LeFemm Armor plug-in.
Gorlar's Sword is an Orsimer bodyguard found protecting Gorlar the Dark in Thukhozod's Sanctum, Wrothgar.
Gorlar's Shield is an Orsimer bodyguard protecting Gorlar the Dark in Thukhozod's Sanctum, Wrothgar.
Golmerea Severin is a Dunmer found aboard The Dreamsnake, a ship docked in Abah's Landing.

Grace of the Ancients is an item set in . It is a 3-piece armor set, and only available in weapons, shields, and jewelry. Pieces are in Alliance styles. It can be obtained in Cyrodiil from merchants or daily quests. Previously, this set appeared only as restoration staves and a ring named after the player's Alliance, all in the Akaviri Style.
Gossamer is an dungeon set that appears in . It can be obtained in the Cradle of Shadows. It was added with the release of DLC. Pieces are Light Armor in the Silken Ring Style.
Grace of Gloom is an overland set that appears in . It can be acquired as a drop from overland activities across Summerset. Generic pieces are Heavy Armor in the Ebonshadow Style.
Golden Sword is a weapon in / that is a part of the Creation Club addon Saints & Seducers. It is part of the Golden Weapons set.
Golden Battleaxe is a weapon in / that is a part of the Creation Club addon Saints & Seducers. It is part of the Golden Weapons set.
Golden Dagger is a weapon in / that is a part of the Creation Club addon Saints & Seducers. It is part of the Golden Weapons set.
Golden Greatsword is a weapon in / that is a part of the Creation Club addon Saints & Seducers. It is part of the Golden Weapons set.
Golden Warhammer is a weapon in / that is a part of the Creation Club addon Saints & Seducers. It is part of the Golden Weapons set.
Gogh's Iron Armor is a piece of armor in that is a part of the Goblins Creation Club content.
Gogh's Iron Helmet is a piece of armor in that is a part of the Goblins Creation Club content.
Gogh's Leather Armor is a piece of armor in that is a part of the Goblins Creation Club content.
Gogh's Leather Helmet is a piece of armor in that is a part of the Goblins Creation Club content.
Gogh's Skull Mask is a piece of armor in that is a part of the Goblins Creation Club content.
Golden Saint Boots is a piece of armor in that is a part of the Saints & Seducers Creation Club content.
Golden Saint Gauntlets is a piece of armor in that is a part of the Saints & Seducers Creation Club content.
Golden Saint Helmet is a piece of armor in that is a part of the Saints & Seducers Creation Club content.
Greaves of Resilient Flesh are Light Armor greaves found in the House of Mania in the Shivering Isles.
The Grand Staff of Charming is a weapon in . This staff is a part of the quest "Onmund's Request" in which Enthir asks for it in exchange for Onmund's Amulet.
The Grand Staff of Turning is a weapon in . This staff's effect emulates the Restoration spell Turn Greater Undead. Charge consumed by the staff's use is reduced by higher restoration skill.

Greed is a unique spear located in the Telvanni Vault. This two-handed weapon is enchanted to grant the wielder a constant twenty percent chance to absorb incoming spells while lowering Personality by five.

Grandmaster's Armorer's Hammer is an item in that, when used on either weapons or armor, increases the Armorer Skill. It can be used a total of 10 times before it disappears, and has a Quality of 1.70, which is the highest in the game.

Gravedigger is a unique two-handed daedric weapon belonging to the Captain of the Royal Guard, Tienius Delitian. This enchanted long blade inflicts paralysis, rendering an adversary unable to move or perform most actions, while simultaneously damaging the victim's Health.

Grayne is an Imperial sailor that appeared in . Grayne first appears in the Prologue to the story as a member of the Wind Oracle ship. Grayne originates from Leyawiin, and she was there when the Oblivion Gates opened up outside of the city. She is described with silver and black bangs, having very weak eyesight. She has eyes that are useless. Before Umbriel appeared before her and the Wind Oracle, she felt the sea tremors and assumed it was a tsunami. Iffech diminished the theory by giving examples from his past. After Keem had died after the mainmast had collapsed, she and Iffech say the floating island approach them, and before they knew it, a foul breeze of wind enveloped them and killed them.
Greaves are an armor piece in . They protect the waist and upper legs and come in leather, chain, and plate.

The Great Axe of the Titanborn is a battleaxe in obtained from Cadwell at the conclusion of the quest "God of Schemes" if Lyris Titanborn was sacrificed. The Great Axe is an heirloom of the Titanborn clan featuring runes representing the deeds of the clan's members.
Grand Champion's Sword is a unique, versatile, slashing weapon found in . It is awarded after the quest "Tournament - Championship Fight."
Greaves of the Warrior-Poet is is an armor piece part of the Warrior-Poet armor set in . It can be acquired by completing the quest, "Divine Delusions."
Grave Guardian is a dungeon set in . It is a Heavy Armor Pyre Watch Style set, and can be found in Unhallowed Grave.
The Grummite Shield is a small shield used by certain classes of Grummite in the expansion.
Grummite Daggers are the most commonly found Grummite weapon. They are serrated on one side, and smooth on the other. They are inlaid with an odd pattern, and are heavier than Daedric Daggers.

Grelka is a Nord who lives in Riften. She trains Light Armor at the Expert-level and serves as a merchant of armor and weapons. During the day, she sells her wares at a booth in the center of town. She sleeps at Haelga's Bunkhouse.
Grey Shaft of Holding is a generic arrow intended for use with a bow. It is enchanted to inflict paralysis, rendering an adversary unable to move or perform almost any actions for ten seconds.
Grimsever's Return is a quest available in in which the Dragonborn must recover the lost glass sword Grimsever for Mjoll the Lioness in Riften.
Grummite Bows are weapons in . Grummite Archers carry this weapon.
Greenspeaker's Grove is a crafting location that appears in the zone of Reaper's March. This location allows the Vestige to craft unique Willow's Path Armor Sets and woodworked items.
Grerid Axe-Wife is a Nord warrior residing on the shore of Lake Fjalding. She is a member of the Skaal and also one of the hunting party members during the Ristaag.
Grinds-Nails is an Argonian clothier in who sells clothing supplies at his stall "Highly Practical Armor" in the Dhalmora Hall of Merchants, Bal Foyen.
The Grimli's War Helm is a piece of medium magic armor in , it grants +10 personality and +15 endurance to those who wear it. Description: "???"
Groken's Great Weapons is Groken's weapon stall in Bleakrock Village.
Grim Shield-Brother is a creature card in that is a part of the expansion.

The Guild Master's Armor is a light armor set found in . It is an improved version of the standard Thieves Guild Armor. All pieces are black-colored and have higher armor values, as well as stronger enchantment compared to the standard set.

Guthrum is a Nord sailor and ranger on the ship The Sea Squall in Dawnstar. He claims how he is starting to get too old for sailing and wants to enjoy the very little time that he has left on the sea.

Grytewake is a smuggler ship located on the Bitter Coast region southwest of Hla Oad and next to Heran Ancestral Tomb. The ship belongs to Velfred the Outlaw and his group of thieves. Ash Statues and narcotics can be found on the decks. If questioned about this, he will state that the Nerevarine has "Seen too much", and will attack.

The Guild Master's Armor is a piece of light armor and part of the Guild Master's Armor Set set found in . It is similar to the standard Thieves Guild Armor, however the armor is colored black and the enchantment is significantly stronger.

Guild Master's Boots are a piece of light armor and part of the Guild Master's armor set set found in . They are similar to the Thieves Guild Boots, however the boots are colored black and the enchantment is significantly stronger.

The Guild Master's Gloves are a piece of light armor and part of the Guild Master's Armor Set set found in . It is similar to the Thieves Guild Gloves, however the gloves are colored black and the enchantment is significantly stronger.

The Guild Master's Hood is a piece of light armor and part of the Guild Master's Armor Set set found in . It is similar to the Thieves Guild Hood, however the hood is colored black and the enchantment is significantly stronger. Another similar hood is Serana's Hood.
Haakon's Lucky Break is a unique silver staff that grants its wielder increased luck for a limited time.

Guard Helmet is a Helmet in . It is quite easy to obtain because almost every Guard wears it. The easiest way to obtain it is to just kill a guard, or pickpocket it while they are asleep in the Guard Barracks. Another way is to let enemies kill the guard by luring them to a city.
Guardian's Hammer is a one-handed weapon the Vestige receives as a reward in the quest "Champion of the Guardians."
Guardian's Gauntlets is a pair of medium armor gauntlets the Vestige receives after completing the quest "Reclaiming the Elements."
Guifford's Mining Helmet is a medium armor helmet the Vestige receives after completing the quest "A Brush with Death."
Guard is a journeyman-level Alteration spell in . Upon cast, it increases the caster's armor rating by 30% for 30 seconds.
Guild Blade is a character residing in the city of Vulkhel Guard.
Gunnjiira is a Nord working at the Axe and Bridle in Morkul Stronghold.
Gwinengur is a Bosmer fighter found in the Gladiator's Quarters of Vivec City. He has no unique dialogue.
Gwinadras is a Bosmer fighter talking to Horulia Agrudilius outside the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City on Vvardenfell. He has no unique dialogue.
Gryphon's Ferocity is an overland set that appears in . It is a Medium Armor set, and can be found on Summerset. Generic pieces are in the Ancient Elf Style.
Guard Sword is a weapon in . It is used by the Guards and can only be acquired by Cyrus with console commands.

The Hall of the Virtues of War were the training grounds for the Sword-Singers of Hammerfell. One of the leaders of this hall was Hallin, the other being Ansei. Ansei was able to single-handingly gather an army of Sword-Singers to stop a Goblin invasion. Of its attendants, two noted members were Frandar Hunding, and later, his son Divad Hunding.
Haema Farseer is a Nord shipmaster in Dagon Fel, Morrowind. She owns a transport ship, the Arrow, and can be found at the docks nearby.
Handedness refers to whether a weapon is one-handed or two-handed in .
The Hands of Midnight are an enchanted pair of leather gloves, a piece of Light Armor in .

The Hammer and Tongs, run by Agnete the Pickled, has weapons and armor for sale in Skingrad. Agnete also offers repair services. This smithy is next to the alchemy store, All Things Alchemical. The entrance opens into the foyer and most often Agnete can be found through the right archway. Armor, weapons and repair hammers, the common smith fare, are found here along with the Helm of Ferocity.

Hammer and Axe is a store located in Bruma. It is run by Fjotreid, who has 800 to barter with. The store sells the unique armor piece Gauntlets of Gluttony and offers armor repairs. Fjotreid's house and private quarters are on the second floor of the building. To the left of the entrance is a cabinet that respawns items worth approximately 700 when sold, although the items change every time.
Haman Forgefire is a famous Nordic blacksmith from the Second Era. He forged notable items such as Okin, a unique war axe. He can be found in The Vault of Haman Forgefire in Coldharbour.
Hammer and Saw Carpentry is a location that appears within the city of Shornhelm.
Hand of Mephala is an item set in . Pieces are Heavy Armor in the Silken Ring Style, and can be found in Cradle of Shadows. It was added with the release of DLC.

Hand Axes are weapons in used to deal damage to enemies. Blocking with a hand axe will reduce, but not completely negate, the damage the Fugitive will receive. They can be crafted or looted and improved at a blacksmith.
Hagraven's Garden is a dungeon set in . It can be obtained from Bloodroot Forge. It is a Heavy Armor set, and items are in the Bloodforge Style.
The Headsman's Axe is a unique weapon in . This battleaxe is wielded by Ahtar, most notably for Roggvir's execution.
Harsh Master is a quest available in in which the Dragonborn must clear out a group of bandits for Kjar, the captain of a ship docked in Windhelm.

Hats are average clothing items that can be worn on the head but cannot be worn along with helmets or circlets. They provide no armor rating but can be enchanted to provide benefits such as Fortify Archery, etc.

The Harborside Warehouse is a warehouse located at the docks of Anvil that the people of the city and ship captains use to store goods and merchandise. It is located between the two docked ships, The Serpent's Wake and the Sea Tub Clarabella. The people allow Wilhelm the Worm to live in the warehouse to "keep out the rats," and he expresses no problems with this arrangement.
Hasty Retreat is a passive skill in the Bow skill line in . It is unlocked at Bow rank 41.
Harayya is a Redguard sword-adept instructor found in the Alik'r Desert.
Hazak's Hauberk is a piece of medium armor in . It is a reward for completing "Moon-Sugar Medicament."
Healer's Habit is an arena set in . It is a Light Armor set, and can be found by defeating enemies and bosses throughout Dragonstar Arena. It can also be traded or bought from other players.
Harm Armor is a spell in . The spell reduces the effectiveness of a target's armor, meaning they take more damage.
Healing Mage is a trial set in . It is a Light Armor Celestial Style set, and can be found in Aetherian Archive.

Hatchling's Shell is an overland set in . It is a Heavy Armor set, and can be obtained in Shadowfen. Generic pieces are in the Argonian Style. Prior to One Tamriel, it was known as Armor of the Construct.

Hawk's Eye is an item set in . It is a Medium Armor set, and can be found in Cyrodiil. Only bows, medium armor, and jewelry may now be obtained in this set. Pieces are in the Alliance styles, with an exception: if one uses a Transmute Station to reconstruct this the helm or shoulders, the pieces will be in the Hawk's Eye Style.

Harthoon's Heavy Eyes is a unique spell in that obscures the vision of the victim, reducing his chance to hit an opponent with weapon or hand-to-hand attacks, while simultaneously temporarily increasing the weight carried by the victim, causing faster fatigue loss.
Headman's Cleaver is a rare, heavy, cleaving, glass weapon found in . It is acquired during the quest "Gabrielle's Treasure." The weapon is originally owned by Barzul gro-Batul.
Hanu's Compassion is a dungeon set in . It is a Light Armor Huntsman Style set, and can be found in March of Sacrifices.
Haven of Ursus is a dungeon set in . It is a Heavy Armor Huntsman Style set, and can be found in March of Sacrifices.
The Heavy Armor skill grants the Hero effective use of heavy armor, which generally is heavier, more durable, and provides better protection than light armor. :Governing attribute: Endurance
Helmet of the Owl is an enchanted light armor fur helmet. The helm can be found randomly as leveled loot, most likely on bandits.

The Helm of Ferocity is a unique piece of enchanted heavy armor sold by Agnete the Pickled at the Hammer and Tongs in Skingrad. It fortifies Blade, Blunt, and Hand-to-Hand by five points each, at the expense of draining Intelligence, Willpower, and Personality by five points each.
Heat Shell is an apprentice-level Alteration spell in . Upon cast, it increases the caster's fire resistance and armor rating by 10% for 30 seconds.
The Helm of the Deep Delver is an enchanted Dwarven helmet that has light, resist poison, and drain speed enchantments. It is for sale at the Three Brothers Trade Goods in the Market District.
Helmet of Magicka Resistance is a mithril helmet in that has a resist magic enchantment.
Heddvild is a Nord Barbarian who resides in Balmora. She wears Fur Armor and uses a Nordic Battle Axe as her weapon.
Helm of Yngol is a unique heavy armor helmet found in . It once belonged to Ysgramor's son, Yngol, who was killed at sea along with his crew by Sea-Ghosts, as described in Yngol and the Sea-Ghosts.
Helm of Winterhold is a unique steel horned helmet and quest item found in . It can be dated back to around 1E 369, when it was worn by Jarl Hanse of Winterhold.
Hefadmir is a Nord rogue smuggler who resides on the ship, Grytewake, near Hla Oad.
The Helmet of the Old Gods is a unique piece of light armor and part of the Armor of the Old Gods set found in .
Helmet of Bearkind is a unique medium helmet that is enchanted with the power to temporarily increase the wearer's Hand-to-Hand skill, Agility, and chance of hitting opponents during combat.
Helm of the Wolf's Heart is a unique light helmet that is enchanted with the power to increase the wearer's Agility attribute and Sneak skill.
Her Dart is a throwing weapon which is enchanted with several effects that dispel magic while simultaneously damaging an opponent with all four elements, and reducing their effectiveness in combat.
Her Ebony Scimitar is a one-handed weapon that is enchanted with magic effects which reduce an opponent's Strength and Fatigue while simultaneously causing Frost Damage.
Helm of Holy Fire is an enchanted helmet that provides a small amount of protection against Fire Damage when used.

Her Tamed Lightning is a unique Alteration ability in that surrounds the caster with a shield of elemental shock, providing resistance to Shock Damage, and damaging nearby adversaries for 10% of the effect's magnitude.
Her Hand's Armor is a heavy armor set found in Mournhold, in .

Her Hand's Cuirass is a piece of heavy armor in . This cuirass belongs to the Her Hand's Armor set worn by High Ordinators in Mournhold. It provides coverage for the chest and groin regions. This piece of armor is worn exclusively by High Ordinators and the Hands of Almalexia. The version worn by the Hands of Almalexia is almost indistinguishable from this piece but carries the constant effect of Fortify Heavy Armor 10 points on self. Wearing either version of this piece of armor will trigger hostilities from any High Ordinators encountered.

Her Hand's Helmet is a piece of heavy armor in . This helmet belongs to the Her Hand's Armor set worn by High Ordinators in Mournhold. It provides protection for the head. This piece of armor is worn exclusively by High Ordinators and the Hands of Almalexia. The version worn by the Hands of Almalexia is virtually indistinguishable from this piece but carries the constant effect of Reflect 5 points on self. Wearing either version of this piece of armor will trigger hostilities from any High Ordinators encountered.

Her Hand's Left Pauldron is a piece of heavy armor in . This pauldron belongs to the Her Hand's Armor set worn exclusively by High Ordinators and the Hands of Almalexia in Mournhold. It provides coverage for the shoulder, upper arm, and forearm. The version worn by the Hands of Almalexia is nearly identical but carries the constant effect of Resist Poison 5 points on self. Unlike the cuirass and the helmet, wearing either version of this piece of armor will not trigger any hostility from High Ordinators encountered.

Her Hand's Right Pauldron is a piece of heavy armor in . This pauldron belongs to the Her Hand's Armor set worn exclusively by High Ordinators and the Hands of Almalexia in Mournhold. It provides coverage for the shoulder, upper arm, and forearm. The version worn by the Hands of Almalexia is almost indistinguishable from this piece but carries the constant effect of Resist Paralysis 5 points on self. Unlike the cuirass and the helmet, wearing either version of this piece of armor will not trigger any hostility from High Ordinators encountered.

Her Hand's Left Gauntlet is a piece of heavy armor in . It belongs to the Her Hand's Armor set worn exclusively by High Ordinators and the Hands of Almalexia in Mournhold. It protects the left hand and wrist. The version worn by the Hands of Almalexia is almost the same as this piece but carries the constant effect of Fortify Strength 5 points on self. Unlike the cuirass and the helmet, wearing either version of this piece of armor will not trigger any hostility from High Ordinators encountered.

Her Hand's Right Gauntlet is a piece of heavy armor in . It belongs to the Her Hand's Armor set worn exclusively by High Ordinators and the Hands of Almalexia in Mournhold. It protects the right hand and wrist. The version worn by the Hands of Almalexia is only distinguishable from this piece by the visual effect of the enchantment Fortify Attack 5 points on self constant effect. Unlike the cuirass and the helmet, wearing either version of this piece of armor will not trigger any hostility from High Ordinators encountered.

Her Hand's Greaves is a piece of heavy armor in . These greaves belong to the Her Hand's Armor set worn by High Ordinators in Mournhold. Greaves cover the upper legs, knees, and groin. This piece of armor is worn exclusively by High Ordinators and the Hands of Almalexia. The version worn by the Hands of Almalexia is visually indistinguishable from this piece but carries the constant effect of Fortify Medium Armor 5 points on self. Unlike the cuirass and the helmet, wearing either version of this piece of armor will not trigger any hostility from High Ordinators encountered.

Her Hand's Boots is a piece of heavy armor in . These boots belong to the Her Hand's Armor set worn by High Ordinators and the Hands of Almalexia in Mournhold. Boots protect the feet and ankles. The version of these boots worn by the Hands of Almalexia are almost identical to the mundane version but carry the constant effect of Fortify Agility 5 points on self. Unlike the cuirass and the helmet, wearing either version of these boots will not trigger any hostility from High Ordinators.

Her Hand's Shield is a heavy shield belonging to the Her Hand's Armor set in . This shield is carried by High Ordinators and the Hands of Almalexia in Mournhold. The version of this shield used by the Hands of Almalexia is nearly identical to the mundane version but has the constant effect of Fortify Block 10 points on self and shimmers. Unlike the cuirass and the helmet, wielding either version of this shield will not trigger any hostility from the High Ordinators.

He is usually located in the South Watch Tower accessible through the Temple District and the Arena. He is the main antagonist of the Thieves Guild questline.

Hide Boots are a piece of light armor and part of the hide armor set found in .

Hide Armor is a set of light armor that appears in . The most basic form of light armor, both in cost and protection, Hide Armor is very common and can be found throughout Skyrim from the beginning of the game. All pieces require the same amount of materials to craft as leather armor, though hide armor offers much lower protection. This makes the set less desirable to craft, minus the shield, for which there is no leather variant.
Hevnoraak's Staff is a unique staff in . Its effect is similar to the dragon priest staff that also creates a wall of lightning.
Hide Braces are a piece of light armor and part of the hide armor set found in .

Herebane's Fortress is a unique Elven shield which was cut from before release. Herebane's Fortress bears similarity to the name of the character Herebane Sorenshield, who was also cut from the final game.
The Hide Shield is a piece of light armor and part of the Hide Armor set.
Hestla is a Nord vampire who resides in Castle Volkihar. She serves as the castle's blacksmith, and will trade in weapons and armor.
Hidden Blade is an active skill in the Dual Wield skill line in . It is unlocked at Dual Wield rank 38.
Heritance Gauntlets is a Heavy Armor pair of gauntlets given to the Vestige from completing the quest "Repentant Son."
Hide of the Werewolf is an overland set in . It can be obtained in Glenumbra. Generic pieces are Medium Armor in the Primal Style.
Hidar is a Nord barbarian residing in Graring's House. After the completion of the quest "Discovery in the Mine," she can forge ice armor and Stalhrim weapons for the Nerevarine.

Herminius Sophus is an Imperial scholar excavating the ruins of Ancestor's Landing. He is looking for a powerful Yokudan sword, and, once it is found, wants to bring it back to the Imperial City for safekeeping. Later, he is found in the Sunken Road, where he is still excavating and searching for ancient artifacts. However, in the midst of his search, his guide Azei at-Owynok mysteriously disappears.
Hillid the Blade is a Redguard ghost found in the Tears of the Dishonored.
Hide of Morihaus is an overland item set found in . It is a Heavy Armor set obtained in the Gold Coast. Pieces are in the Minotaur Style.
Herebane Sorenshield is an unused Imperial in . He wears a full set of Imperial Armor and a closed Imperial Officer's Helmet.
Hillemir is a Redguard fighter residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. He is located within the Gnisis Mine Barracks. His profession is a kwama-wrangler, and his duties lean to the mine in Gnisis.
The High Elf Style is a type of crafting style that appears in . It is crafted using Adamantite. The appearance of the armor piece depends on the material it is crafted with.

Hjalti's Sword is a unique ancient Nord sword and a quest item that is required to complete the quest "The Ghost of Old Hroldan."

Hold Guards wear very similar armor sets, differences are normally just the color of the sash and material of the undershirt used, either scaled or quilted. They also wear the same model of helmet, however the colors vary depending on the hold.
Hjalti is a dog which can be found in Battlehorn Castle. He is added with the Fighter's Stronghold plug-in.
